guides.favoredWhen: Briar is the underdog head-on; her windows are counterganks and late fight entries after Cocoon and Rappel are spent.

keyTips.text: Elise is one of Briar's hardest matchups because both of her E answers stop a run-in: Cocoon stuns it and Rappel untargetably dodges it. Never force the duel; answer her instead.
Join fights after they start, not first. Her control lands easiest on the opening diver, so be the second entry and close with W-Q ({cd:233:W}) once her attention is split.
Fire W1 only from range where Q lands instantly after. A long W1 run with a late Q is the exact sequence she punishes with Cocoon or Rappel.

tips.text: When Elise shows on a gank, path to her and countergank rather than forcing your own play elsewhere. She wins the straight duel, so meet her at her fight instead of taking a fair one.
tips.heading: Answer, don't force

tips.text: Let skirmishes start before you enter. Cocoon ({cd:60:E}) is hardest to land on a mover who arrives late, and a spent Cocoon is your cue to W-Q in.
Approach from fog. Closing across open ground lets her pre-aim Cocoon or hold Rappel for your Q; brush and flank angles cut that reaction window down.
Set up mid-game approaches from brush. Starting W1 out of vision shortens the distance she has to react to your entry.
tips.heading: Brush approaches

tips.text: Make W1 and Q one motion. Q the instant you are close; the gap between a far W1 and a late Q is where her E answers live.
Watch her E before committing. If Cocoon just caught a teammate, her best peel is down ({cd:60:E}) and your W-Q window is open.
Win as the second engage, never the first. Let someone else draw Cocoon and Rappel, then enter late and stay on the backline through the cleanup.
tips.heading: Second entry

tips.text: Keep playing the countergank game around objectives. Elise wants picks with her control, so cover the lane she leans toward and turn her attempt into your fight.

itemization.text: Go bruiser instead of full damage. Sterak's Gage plus Spirit Visage lets you eat the Cocoon focus, live through the Rappel stall, and still land the Q follow-up.

keyTips.text: Clear fully into Scuttle, then pick the next fight from what the map actually shows.
Never start Blood Frenzy without a target and direction that favor the fight, and keep E ready to cancel it out.
Convert Q picks on isolated enemies into camps, vision, or objectives instead of sitting in long full-team fights.

tips.text: Try the one-camp invade only when tracking puts the enemy jungler elsewhere and nearby lanes can move.
Counter-gank early skirmishes hard, since Briar duels well once an enemy shows or hits a teammate.
Track the opposing jungler through map sightings and camp states before entering their side.
Close gaps under control with W1 into Q for target priority, then spend W2 only when the return strike stays safe.
Trade across the map when an ally already loses a lane instead of re-spending time on a hopeless rescue.
Pick skirmishes with teammates or positional edges, and leave drawn-out team brawls early.
Invade only with a known enemy jungler spot plus lane backup nearby.
Before an objective, read the map and wait for the entry Briar team wins.
Steal Dragon with W over the wall into Q priority plus W2 and Smite only as a high-risk last resort.
Around Baron, respect its knockback, which can break the W2-plus-Smite timing.
Snowball informed skirmishes and invades into finished items.
Let the enemy show an opening late, then flank or pick with Certain Death and turn it into an objective or another kill.
Stay a calculated skirmisher around camps and objectives; never charge blind into groups or W without an exit.
Punish mispositioning with the Q stun and plan every fight around both it and the E escape.

itemization.text: Run Press the Attack with Triumph, Legend: Haste, and Coup de Grace, plus Sudden Impact and Treasure Hunter.
Rush Titanic Hydra and Black Cleaver on the high-elo bruiser path, then Plated Steelcaps, Endless Hunger, Death's Dance, and Guardian Angel.
Take Blade of the Ruined King into Black Cleaver as the alternate bruiser route, with Death's Dance and Spirit Visage for durability.
Pick the Hail of Blades assassin setup of Voltaic Cyclosword, The Collector, and Edge of Night only when picks beat frontline duty.
Take Flash and Smite, and match the pet to the game: Gustwalker, Mosstomper, or Scorchclaw.
